dinners.name: Pan-seared pork chops with herb butter
dinners.note: GF as written (recipe serves 2). Roast sweet potato wedges and 1 broccoli crown at 425°F while the chops cook.

dinners.name: Korean beef bowls
dinners.note: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce. One 450 g pack of beef makes the full recipe (2 dinners + lunch leftovers). Serve over rice with the second broccoli crown.

dinners.name: Sweet and spicy glazed salmon
dinners.note: Tagged GF; check the sweet chili sauce and sriracha labels. Use ~3/4 lb salmon for 2. Serve with rice and garlicky sautéed bok choy.

dinners.name: Thai chicken lettuce cups
dinners.note: Halve the recipe (454 g ground chicken). Use GF tamari for the soy sauce (the recipe's own GF note) and check the fish sauce label. Serve with rice. Thaw the fish tonight.

dinners.name: Fish tacos with avocado sweet corn slaw
dinners.note: Halve the recipe. Use the 400 g white fish fillets instead of mahi mahi, green cabbage instead of purple, frozen corn, and GF-labelled corn tortillas. Check the garlic salt, chili powder and mayo labels.

dinners.name: Mushroom & spinach pasta with ricotta
dinners.note: Use Rizopia GF rice pasta instead of bowtie pasta and save some pasta water. Full recipe uses both mushroom packs; use ~1/2 cup ricotta.

groceries.name: Bone-in pork combination chops (pick 2 thick centre-cut)
Lean ground beef, 2x450 g
groceries.note: Use one 450 g pack Monday; freeze the other.

groceries.name: Fresh Atlantic salmon fillets
groceries.note: Ad is a family pack; if they insist on the pack size, freeze the extra.

groceries.name: Extra lean ground chicken, 454 g
groceries.note: Ad is Prime (Maple Leaf) brand; match depends on No Frills carrying it. Otherwise any 454 g ground chicken.

groceries.name: SeaQuest fish fillets, 400 g (frozen)
groceries.note: Pick a plain (unbreaded) white fish like basa, haddock or cod.
